annotations.title: Have one webhook link or fetch fill several sheets

description: One service, several sheets: a track's webhook link, or one of its scheduled fetches, can also fill other tracks of the person's, each reading it with its own hacks, so the service is set up once (Stripe into a sales sheet and a budget, one Instagram token for two sheets). action list shows the track's connections, the other tracks each hacks, and the other tracks' connections that fill this one; add takes kind (webhook or fetch, with fetchId from scheduled_fetches) and alsoTrackId; remove takes the same. The other track only gets rows its own hacks read: turn one on there first (turn_on_ready_hack, use_community_hack or save_hack). What its hacks don't read isn't written to it; anything no sheet reads waits in the Inbox of the track the link or fetch is on. turn_on_ready_hack does this by itself when the service already posts to another of the person's sheets on another topic.

alsoTrackId.description: add, remove: the other track, from list_tracks.

fetchId.description: add, remove with kind fetch: from scheduled_fetches.

kind.description: add, remove: the track's webhook link, or one of its fetches.

trackId.description: The track the link or fetch is on.
